# IMG Helping Hands

> IMG Helping Hands is a comprehensive platform guiding international medical graduates through US residency preparation, ERAS application optimization, clinical experience, and board exam success.

IMG Helping Hands specializes in mentorship and coaching for international medical graduates (IMGs) pursuing US medical residency. The organization provides services spanning ERAS portfolio development, USMLE preparation, clinical rotations, research mentorship, and personalized interview coaching to help IMGs successfully match into residency programs.

## Key Topics

- International Medical Graduates (IMG)
- ERAS Application
- USMLE Preparation
- Residency Match
- Clinical Rotations
- Personal Statement Editing
- CV Optimization
- US Clinical Experience (USCE)
- Interview Preparation
- Medical Mentorship
- Clinical Research
- Internal Medicine
- Pediatrics
- Residency Timeline
- Application Coaching

## Core Services & Products

- [Our Products](https://imghelpinghands.com/products): Product catalog: ERAS CV editing, personal statements, interview prep, USMLE crash courses.
- [ERAS CV Editing for IMGs](https://imghelpinghands.com/eras-cv-editing): Professional ERAS CV editing service tailored by resident physicians for IMG applicants.
- [Personal Statement Editing Services](https://imghelpinghands.com/personal-statement-editing): Expert personal statement editing service for IMG residency applications.
- [Clinical Rotations](https://imghelpinghands.com/clinical-rotations): In-person clinical rotation booking across multiple medical specialties for IMGs.
- [Virtual Rotation](https://imghelpinghands.com/virtual-rotation): Virtual clinical rotations in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, Pediatrics, and OB/GYN.

## ERAS & Residency Application

- [ERAS Portfolio Building](https://imghelpinghands.com/eras-portfolio-building): ERAS portfolio building guide: CV optimization and personal statement editing for IMGs.
- [Residency Interview Preparation](https://imghelpinghands.com/residency-interview-preparation): 2025 residency match strategies, timeline guides, and interview preparation for IMGs.
- [IMG Helping Hands Homepage](https://imghelpinghands.com): IMG Helping Hands homepage: ERAS, USMLE prep, research, and US clinical rotations for IMGs.

## USMLE & Medical Education

- [USMLE STEP 1 IMPACT THEORY](https://imghelpinghands.com/product/usmle-step-1-impact-theory): USMLE Step 1 Impact Theory course: master test strategy and answer reasoning for residency success.
- [US Clinical Experience (USCE) for IMGs](https://imghelpinghands.com/us-clinical-experience): Guide to US Clinical Experience rotations and observerships for IMG residency preparation.

## Research & Professional Development

- [Clinical Research Modules](https://imghelpinghands.com/research-modules): Clinical research modules: study design, data collection, and publication mentorship for IMGs.
- [Working as a Supervised Physician before Residency](https://imghelpinghands.com/working-as-a-supervised-physician-before-residency): Guide to limited licensed physician practice and supervised clinical work before residency.
